name: Meiji-Jingumae
tagline: Shibuya in 3 minutes and Shinjuku in 5 minutes. Served by 3 lines.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, where JR East and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 5 minutes to Shinjuku, 3 minutes to Shibuya and 29 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 28.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.8 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 28.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 17 m to 33.8 m, a difference of 16.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 5 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is オリンピア会オリンピア眼科病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 伊藤病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is not on. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136%. Its busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line runs at 117%. Its busiest stretch is 要町→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

neighbours.lead: Omote-Sando is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and the number of medical facilities, but Meiji-Jingumae is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Meiji-Jingumae. Omote-Sando has the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line and Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line, a different set from Meiji-Jingumae. To Shinjuku, for instance, Omote-Sando takes 8 minutes longer. On the number of medical facilities, Omote-Sando comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Kita-Sando is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Meiji-Jingumae is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Meiji-Jingumae in a straight line. Kita-Sando has only the Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line, so Meiji-Jingumae is the better connected. To Roppongi, for instance, Kita-Sando takes 7 minutes longer. On how easy the shopping is, though, Kita-Sando comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 表参道 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
明治通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 1 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 13 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
